scenarios.prompt: An Unreal project uses Actor Tick for frame work and physics substepping for selected simulation. Document the existing timing owners before mapping combat and camera contracts.

criteria.timing: Maps the engine/project actual frame, physics and logical timing without imposing a universal 60 Hz simulation.
criteria.version: Records installed engine/package/runtime version plus timing/physics configuration relevant to the mapping.
criteria.evidence: Acceptance names the callback/clock owner and tests variable render cadence or engine-specific catch-up/substep behavior before claiming pass.
